Hi WNC,

We are putting together a January gathering in the Studio. We would like slides and light background music, would bring an outside caterer, and may ask WNC for a short facilitator-led opening. We know a DJ setup is not available, which is fine. Could you also explain the booking fee and whether there is any room to adjust it? We are still confirming final numbers and timing.

Thank you,
Ari
